rows.name: crowdy.entity.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication entity activity: registry add/remove, event routing and dispatch, entity components, and actor tracking/management. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication Game Model activity: identity resolution, invoke client, container cache/diffing, and effect lowering. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.hud.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices HUD activity: HUD base and widgets. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.net.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet UDP transport activity: socket open/close, message sends and receives, worker-thread pool, and buffer pool churn. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.pool.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication actor-pool activity: spawn, release, reuse, and rendering-backend churn. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.query.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet GraphQL activity: query dispatch and responses. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.reliable.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs just the reliable (channel-transport) RPC path: a Multicast CrowdyEvent's channel send and the matching receive on every member. Narrower than crowdy.rpc.trace, which covers all RPC sends and receives; either one surfaces the reliable lines.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs every CrowdyEvent RPC send and receive: function, entity, addressing, owned/delegated classification, and parameter byte size.

rows.name: crowdy.sdk.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs top-level CrowdySDK activity: subsystem lifecycle and configuration / gameplay-tag path registration. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.serialize.scopes
rows.help: When non-zero, emits the fine-grained CPU trace scopes inside payload decode. Each one costs two timestamps per received message and is nested inside a scope that is itself measured, so it is off by default and a reading must say whether the run carried it.

rows.name: crowdy.serialize.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyNet payload serialization: message encode/decode and payload/class registry resolves. High frequency, so off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.services.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyServices activity: authentication, teams, avatars, persistence, host subsystem, utilities, and Blueprint reception. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.state.scopes
rows.help: When non-zero, emits a CPU trace scope around each CrowdyState delta decode. Nested inside the enclosing delivery scope, so it shifts that scope's own figure: turn it on only for a run that needs the split. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.state.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyReplication CrowdyState replicator activity: owned-entity diffing, delta emission, and datagram sizes. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.studio.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs each CrowdyStudio console GraphQL op: its plane, operation name, and outcome (HTTP code, error count). The bearer token is never logged. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.voice.trace
rows.help: When non-zero, logs CrowdyVoice activity: voice chat subsystem, capture/playback service, and audio device monitoring. Off by default.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.bulkresolve
rows.help: 1: shared (Host-owned) entities and remote copies of other players' entities bind their Game Model containers from one paged list per type; 0: one call per entity.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.emitfallbackping
rows.help: 1 (default): acting client emits a fallback model-changed ping after a successful Game Model invoke so peers re-pull. 0: rely solely on the server-native model-driven notification (isolates that path in 2-client PIE).

rows.name: crowdy.net.http2
rows.help: Asks for HTTP/2 on the SDK's own requests, falling back to HTTP/1.1 when the server does not offer it; 0 leaves the engine's HTTP version. With HTTP/2 the curl diagnostics the engine logs for a failed request can include the request headers, bearer token included, so set 0 if you ship logs from builds with logging enabled.

rows.name: crowdy.net.receive.poolactorupdates
rows.help: Reuse actor update message objects instead of allocating one per received message (default 1). Turn it off to measure what the pool is worth on the same build.

rows.name: crowdy.net.retry.busy
rows.help: Sends an SDK query again, up to 3 times with backoff, when the platform refuses it and says to retry (blame PLATFORM, retryable); a container ensure or an invoke is sent again only when the platform says the work never started (PLATFORM_BUSY). 0 hands every refusal straight to the caller.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.allowObjectLoad
rows.help: When non-zero, a received object or class reference whose asset is not already resident is loaded from disk by path. Default 0 (find-only) so an untrusted peer cannot trigger arbitrary asset loads; an unresolved reference is delivered as null.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.loopback
rows.help: When non-zero, a sent replicated CrowdyEvent is also delivered to this client's own receive path, so the whole serialize/resolve/dispatch round-trip can be tested without a second client. The call runs once locally through that path; a call made from the replayed body is sent normally but does not loop back, so there is no cascade.

rows.name: crowdy.state.loopback
rows.help: When non-zero, a sent CrowdyState delta for an owned entity is also decoded onto a local 'mirror' entity (a lazily-spawned second instance of the same class, RemoteProxy role, a distinct NetID) so decode/OnRep/host-authority checks can be exercised from one PIE client. Unlike crowdy.rpc.loopback this cannot replay onto the same actor (an owner's own entity silently drops a non-host-sourced delta, and decode's changed-detection would report no change against identical values); the mirror is a genuinely distinct receive target instead.

rows.name: crowdy.cpp.selftest
rows.help: Link + exception-containment self test for the vendored CrowdyCPP library.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.stats
rows.help: Log how the Game Model has used the network since the last reset: pulls, applies, self-echoes, resolves, invokes, per-operation latency and transport bytes.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.stats.reset
rows.help: Zero the counters crowdy.gamemodel.stats reports, including the API client's per-operation and transport totals.[GameModel] net stats reset.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.unwatchcontainers
rows.help: Close the container-change feed opened by crowdy.gamemodel.watchcontainers.

rows.name: crowdy.gamemodel.watchcontainers
rows.help: Open the server's container-change feed over a WebSocket and log every notification. Optional argument narrows it to one container type. Diagnostic only: nothing is re-pulled from it. Run with no argument again, or crowdy.gamemodel.unwatchcontainers, to close it.

rows.name: crowdy.net.routes
rows.help: Prints the network router's subscription table: every payload key and opcode, with the struct behind it where one is registered, and every subscriber by role.

rows.name: crowdy.rpc.dumpfn
rows.help: Reports what a Crowdy event is in this process: resolved, replicated, its recipient, its FunctionID, and whether its compiled body carries the dispatch gate. Args: <ClassPathOrName> <FunctionName>. A Blueprint class name ends in _C.

rows.name: crowdy.schema.RetagAssets
rows.help: One-time migration: resaves every Blueprint the Game Model container scan cannot yet answer for from its asset-registry tags, parent-first, so the scan's fast path covers the whole project. Run on a clean sync with no other outstanding changes; expect version-stamp diff noise.

rows.name: crowdy.state.heartbeat.advisories
rows.help: Lists every CrowdyState enum property this process found outside the keyframe heartbeat, and how many resolutions each one's single warning stands for.
